name: opencut
description: Find social-ready clips from local OpenCut transcripts with the agent model you already use.

interface.shortDescription: Turn transcripts into review-ready social clips
interface.longDescription: Uses your current coding agent to score bounded transcript candidates, then lets OpenCut validate, rank, and package exact-timestamp suggestions for human review.
defaultPrompt: Find 61-second TikTok clips in my transcript.
Find 15-second reels and make a review package.
Resume my OpenCut clip discovery session.
